verdict.rationale: CT Corporation's compliance and entity-management software could plausibly offer automation workflows, so this axis applies. The evidence pack holds only two robots.txt probes: one hit a Cloudflare challenge and the other redirects into the walled host. Neither says anything about versioning, reviewing, or rolling back automations, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
